frozen_before: any episode of confirmation block 2500001 is run
decided_by: PI decision: STOP V1, freeze SDS_G1_4, prepare 2500001 confirmation
what_this_is: The first evolved opponent to satisfy every frozen development-eligibility criterion. This is a DISCOVERY milestone, NOT scientific confirmation. Search numbers are not Gate B evidence.

candidate_genome.canonical_registry_untouched: OP6-OP12 are never overwritten; this is an overlay on the OP6 dispatch key

stop_discipline.why_v1_was_stopped_manually: The frozen protocol says a development-eligible candidate triggers STOP and human review. V1's implementation only writes summary.json after all 6 generations, so it kept searching past eligibility. That is an ORCHESTRATION BUG, not permission to continue. Generations 3-6 must not influence which candidate is selected.
stop_discipline.stop_order: chain supervisor -> watchdog -> worker. Chain first so a deliberate stop could not be mislabelled as an infrastructure failure; watchdog second so it could not relaunch the worker.
stop_discipline.post_eligibility_rows_status: RETAINED FOR PROVENANCE, EXCLUDED FROM CANDIDATE SELECTION
stop_discipline.selection_cannot_have_been_cherry_picked: SDS_G1_4 is the ONLY development-eligible row among all 23. Every post-eligibility row is strictly worse on delta_G (-0.750 to +0.000). There was no better candidate to prefer, so 'searched until the nicest one appeared' is not an available objection.
